statement: Historical hid-sony rejects DS4 probe on failed calibration GET; it retries 0x02 USB report-ID mismatches and 0x05 Bluetooth CRC mismatches, and requests version 0xA3 before registering ordinary functionality.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-sony.c 1704–1788, 2850–2862. Distinct from later kernel's non-fatal DS4 calibration policy.
